head.title: Deliveries to the Pavilion
head.lede: Instructions for couriers, suppliers and hauliers. The Armenian Pavilion is in Tesa 41, inside the Arsenale Militare: deliveries arrive on foot or by water.
opt1.label: Option 1
opt1.title: On foot
opt1.body: The most common way: for parcels and materials that can be carried by hand or on a trolley.
opt1.li-1: Arsenale Militare entrance at the Celestia
opt1.li-2: A few minutes’ walk to Tesa 41
opt2.label: Option 2
opt2.title: By water
opt2.body: For bulky, heavy or palletised loads, unloaded at the pavilion’s landing.
contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.intro: To agree a day and time, or if you run into any trouble:
foot.label: Option 1 · On foot
foot.title: Delivery on foot
foot.lede: For parcels and materials that can be carried by hand or on a trolley. The pavilion is a few minutes’ walk from the Arsenale Militare entrance at the Celestia, beside the Chiesa di Cristo Re alla Celestia.
foot.caption: From the Celestia entrance (yellow dot) to the pavilion: a few minutes on foot.
foot.step-1: Go to the Arsenale Militare entrance at the Celestia, beside the Chiesa di Cristo Re alla Celestia (Fondamenta Case Nuove).
foot.step-2: At the entrance, say that this is a delivery for the Armenian Pavilion – Tesa 41.
foot.step-3: Follow the route highlighted on the map inside the Arsenale.
foot.step-4: Tesa 41 is a few minutes’ walk away.
water.label: Option 2 · By water
water.title: Delivery by boat
water.lede: Boats carrying materials for the Armenian Pavilion may enter the Arsenale Militare. The Marine Office has been informed, but the procedure below must be followed.
card.subtitle: Water access · Armenian Pavilion – Tesa 41
card.before-body: Call the Marine Office and say:
card.before-quote: “I am arriving with a delivery for the Armenian Pavilion.”
card.entrance-name: Galeazze – North Lagoon side – Rio delle Galeazze
card.entrance-body: The boat must approach from the North Lagoon and enter through Rio delle Galeazze.
card.entrance-warn: Do not use any other entrance to the Arsenale.
card.step-1: Approach from the North Lagoon side.
card.step-2: Before entering, call the Marine Office.
card.step-3: Enter through the only permitted entrance: Galeazze – Rio delle Galeazze.
card.step-4: Continue south along Rio delle Galeazze, following the route shown on the map.
card.step-5: Reach the Armenian Pavilion landing (red dot on the map) and unload there.
card.map-caption: Unloading point: the Armenian Pavilion landing on Rio delle Galeazze, beside Tesa 41.
check.label: Before you set off
check.title: Checklist
check.label-p: Mark every package clearly: “Padiglione Armenia – Tesa 41”.
check.time-p: Let us know in advance to fix the delivery, so that someone is there to receive the materials.
check.route-p: On foot for parcels carried by hand or on a trolley; by water for bulky or heavy loads.
check.call-p: The Marine Office must be told before you enter Rio delle Galeazze.
check.thanks: Thank you for your help: a well-prepared delivery reaches the studio without a hitch.
